name: Wanru Pang
title: PhD Candidate in Applied Linguistics
department: Department of Language Science and Technology
educationIntro: I hold an MA in Chinese Culture and Language from the National University of Singapore and a BA in Chinese Linguistics and Literature from the University of Chinese Academy of Social Sciences.
bio: My research focuses on Chinese as a second language, with particular interests in bicultural identity integration, L2 selves, and reading and writing assessment. I combine qualitative inquiry with quantitative modelling to understand learners’ experiences and development over time.

projects.title: First-language proficiency and English reading comprehension among multilingual learners in British Columbia
projects.funding: Social Sciences and Humanities Research Council of Canada
details: Conduct parent and child interviews on bilingual literacy, home language practices, and family support.
Refine interview protocols and prepare Mandarin interview data for thematic analysis.
Observe language use and literacy instruction in mainstream and heritage-language classrooms.

projects.title: Motivation, engagement and task performance in L2 Chinese integrated writing: developmental trajectories and longitudinal associations
projects.funding: General Research Fund, Research Grants Council of Hong Kong
details: Coordinate a multi-cohort longitudinal mixed-methods project, including pilot testing, instrument development, and school-based data collection.
Develop interview frameworks, semi-structured protocols and coding schemes; conduct English-language interviews with secondary CSL learners and thematic analysis in NVivo.
Coordinate questionnaires and writing tasks across four cohorts over four years, school liaison, writing assessment and dataset preparation.
Recruit and coordinate research assistants and student helpers, and prepare manuscripts.

projects.title: Undergraduate students’ peer- and self-initiated feedback on academic writing
details: Supported literature review, data collection, interviews and focus groups.
Assisted with transcription and quantitative analysis, including CFA and SEM.
